[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Neff''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] officer assigned to the [[Sixth Negative Regions|Black Sword Command]]. Based in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]], Neff was present when the [[Yevetha]] of [[N'zoth]], repressed by the personnel of Imperial [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] [[Black Fifteen]], revolted in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] across the Cluster. Neff was one of those captured in the uproar.<ref name="BF3" />

Neff survived the revolt, however, and was instrumental in developing a secret [[slave circuit]]ry that surviving Imperial captives used to free themselves and their [[Starship/Legends|ships]] from Yevethan control [[26 ABY/Legends|twelve years later]].<ref name="BF3" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Neff is given a mention in the ''[[The Black Fleet Crisis]]'' novel ''[[Tyrant's Test]]'' by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].
